headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high‑flying performers and modest guidance revisions.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit margins stayed strong for most firms, with HCLTech and TCS above 20%. AI contributed noticeably to earnings, especially at HCLTech and Mphasis. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but remained upbeat elsewhere.

themes.title: AI as profit driver
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue and deals boosted profit growth at HCLTech, Mphasis and Infosys.

themes.title: Revenue guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1‑2%, reflecting slower top‑line momentum.

themes.title: Strong margin expansion
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin target to 16% and delivered it; TCS maintained a 24% operating margin.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance
21% profit jump and strong AI revenue of $219 m

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and guidance cut
Revenue grew 9.1% but profit fell 1.9% YoY
